I put my hand in my chair, Jesus, like in the mornings when I was settled in the tiny garden of my "noble" house, and I wait, with Blacky at my feet, for the kitchen to be open. The Pole will want us to have it in my car. It's been a plant for a month now, and the three beautiful days have been wonderful. Everything is going great. A doctor said it was normal and that the baby would probably come between the 25th and the 5th. I would obviously like to be near a big city to put the child in. He said here it's not the easiest place in the world. In Ussel there's nothing, you have to go all the way to Tulle which is 60 km away. The days are very monotonous here; we don't feel like doing anything but sleeping, eating, peeing and waiting for the letters. I've read some good books and I've done a little DIY.
